intro: Good evening, gentlemen. Gameweek 6 is done. Results included Arsenal 2-1 Leeds, Aston Villa 2-2 Brentford and Chelsea 5-1 Bournemouth. Brahmes top-scored with 55; Jack managed 29. Ben leads on 308, 3 clear of Asher. Ben climbs 1 to 1st. Carry on.
motw: Brahmes scored 55, the best of the week. Cunha (10), Rogers (9) and N.Jackson (9) did the heavy lifting. Now 6th on 246.
stinker: 29 points. That's the lot. Mbeumo top-scored with 8, which tells you how the rest went. Down 2 to 7th.
bench: 11 points left on the bench. Donnarumma (9), N.Williams (1) and Ndiaye (1) watched from the side. Team selection remains an art, not a science.
bench_jam: Castagne didn't play, so Rúben came off Jamie's bench and scored 6. A clean sheet. Luck is a skill if you say it confidently.
gloves: Horníček (Newcastle) scored 0 for Jamie. Conceded 4. Made 2 saves, for what it's worth.
